methodology.included: Matches marked complete with exactly five valid role picks per side
methodology.pickRate: Champion picks divided by completed matches on that patch
methodology.banRate: Matches containing a ban of that champion divided by completed matches on that patch
methodology.banRateNote: Bans are deduplicated per match; ban rates are global, not role-specific.
methodology.matchupRate: Same-role champion wins divided by completed games against the opposing champion on that patch.
methodology.synergyRate: Team wins divided by completed games in which both allied champions appeared together on that patch.
methodology.limitations: Rates describe included historical professional matches, not causal counter strength or guaranteed performance. Small samples are uncertain.
